name: mcp-server-ftp
description: Model Context Protocol server for FTP access

FTP_PORT.title: Port
FTP_PORT.description: Server port. Leave empty for 21 (FTP/FTPS) or 22 (SFTP).

FTP_PROTOCOL.title: Protocol
FTP_PROTOCOL.description: ftp (also used for FTPS) or sftp.

FTP_USER.title: Username
FTP_USER.description: Username; supports encrypted enc: values. Defaults to anonymous.

FTP_SECURE.title: Use FTPS
FTP_SECURE.description: FTP only: true enables TLS (FTPS). Ignored for SFTP.

FTP_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED.title: Verify FTPS certificate
FTP_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED.description: FTPS only: false allows a trusted self-signed certificate but disables certificate and hostname checks.

FTP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.title: SFTP private key path
FTP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.description: SFTP only: SSH private-key path or op:// 1Password reference. Auto-detected when empty.

FTP_PASSPHRASE.title: SFTP key passphrase
FTP_PASSPHRASE.description: SFTP only: private-key passphrase; supports encrypted enc: values.

FTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.title: Encryption key
FTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 64-character hex AES-256 key for enc: credentials. Prefer the OS keychain for local installs.

FTP_LOCAL_ROOTS.title: Local roots
FTP_LOCAL_ROOTS.description: Local folders the upload-local-file and download-to-local tools may use, separated by : (macOS/Linux) or ; (Windows). Local file tools are off when empty.
